note: Entries the devs deleted outright, transcribed from published patch notes. A catalog diff cannot tell these apart from an ordinary withdrawal — an absent id looks the same either way — so this list is curated by hand and merged into data/legacy.json by scripts/build_legacy.py. Add a block per patch that announces removals.

removals.summary: Broken or unbalanced property found in live player or faction holdings, removed with no plans for restoring.
removals.facilities_note: One live Weaving Bench was removed with its full cumulative construction cost refunded, plus any queued-job escrow. legacy.json carries no facilities section yet, so this id is recorded here only.
